code: const BASE='https://style-store-production.up.railway.app';function headers(){let body=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:false;const h={};const token=localStorage.getItem('ss_token');if(token)h['Authorization']="Bearer ".concat(token);if(body)h['Content-Type']='application/json';return h;}async function handle(res){const data=await res.json();if(!res.ok)throw new Error(data.erro||'Erro na requisicao');return data;}const api={get:p=>fetch("".concat(BASE).concat(p),{headers:headers()}).then(handle),post:(p,b)=>fetch("".concat(BASE).concat(p),{method:'POST',headers:headers(true),body:JSON.stringify(b)}).then(handle),put:(p,b)=>fetch("".concat(BASE).concat(p),{method:'PUT',headers:headers(true),body:JSON.stringify(b)}).then(handle),patch:(p,b)=>fetch("".concat(BASE).concat(p),{method:'PATCH',headers:headers(true),body:JSON.stringify(b)}).then(handle),del:p=>fetch("".concat(BASE).concat(p),{method:'DELETE',headers:headers()}).then(handle)};export default api;
